meta.title: Light of the Sky
meta.description: Break free of this cage and see the light once more.

units.rawText: A few minutes into the pursuit, Antonina comes to a halt.
units.displayText: A few minutes into the pursuit, Antonina comes to a halt.

spans.text: A few minutes into the pursuit, Antonina comes to a halt.

units.rawText: Tsk... I lost her!
units.displayText: Tsk... I lost her!

spans.text: Tsk... I lost her!

options.rawText: I can't believe you'd lose track of someone.
options.displayText: I can't believe you'd lose track of someone.

spans.text: I can't believe you'd lose track of someone.

options.rawText: Do we have any other solutions?
options.displayText: Do we have any other solutions?

spans.text: Do we have any other solutions?

units.rawText: You'll live longer if you don't say things that make people want to beat you up, Professor~
units.displayText: You'll live longer if you don't say things that make people want to beat you up, Professor~

spans.text: You'll live longer if you don't say things that make people want to beat you up, Professor~

units.rawText: Back to the point, did the signal vanish?
units.displayText: Back to the point, did the signal vanish?

spans.text: Back to the point, did the signal vanish?

units.rawText: Not for the moment.
units.displayText: Not for the moment.

spans.text: Not for the moment.

units.rawText: Did the signal vanish?
units.displayText: Did the signal vanish?

spans.text: Did the signal vanish?

units.rawText: Simply put, I was tracking her through her signal strength. As the only Entropic leader in the entire underground, tracking that High-Order Entropic should have been easy.
units.displayText: Simply put, I was tracking her through her signal strength. As the only Entropic leader in the entire underground, tracking that High-Order Entropic should have been easy.

spans.text: Simply put, I was tracking her through her signal strength. As the only Entropic leader in the entire underground, tracking that High-Order Entropic should have been easy.

units.rawText: Then she directed all her Entropics to cluster up to disrupt my scans. Now all the Entropic signals are of similar strength.
units.displayText: Then she directed all her Entropics to cluster up to disrupt my scans. Now all the Entropic signals are of similar strength.

spans.text: Then she directed all her Entropics to cluster up to disrupt my scans. Now all the Entropic signals are of similar strength.

units.rawText: She's learning faster than expected.
units.displayText: She's learning faster than expected.

spans.text: She's learning faster than expected.

units.rawText: A rare look of frustration appears on Antonina's face.
units.displayText: A rare look of frustration appears on Antonina's face.

spans.text: A rare look of frustration appears on Antonina's face.

units.rawText: I was careless...
units.displayText: I was careless...

spans.text: I was careless...
Borrow Antonina's tracking device.
Try looking for other clues.

units.rawText: Let me take a look at the tracker.
units.displayText: Let me take a look at the tracker.

spans.text: Let me take a look at the tracker.

units.rawText: What... Fine, considering your crazy ideas sometimes work out.
units.displayText: What... Fine, considering your crazy ideas sometimes work out.

spans.text: What... Fine, considering your crazy ideas sometimes work out.

units.rawText: I take the tracker from Antonina and study it.
units.displayText: I take the tracker from Antonina and study it.

spans.text: I take the tracker from Antonina and study it.

units.rawText: The green display is covered in red dots. The size of these red dots seem to indicate the strength of a signal.
units.displayText: The green display is covered in red dots. The size of these red dots seem to indicate the strength of a signal.

spans.text: The green display is covered in red dots. The size of these red dots seem to indicate the strength of a signal.

units.rawText: However, as Antonina said, all the red dots look pretty much the same now.
units.displayText: However, as Antonina said, all the red dots look pretty much the same now.

spans.text: However, as Antonina said, all the red dots look pretty much the same now.

units.rawText: However, I discover something she may have overlooked...
units.displayText: However, I discover something she may have overlooked...

spans.text: However, I discover something she may have overlooked...

units.rawText: Look at this area—
units.displayText: Look at this area—

spans.text: Look at this area—

units.rawText: What's over here...? Wait a minute!
units.displayText: What's over here...? Wait a minute!

spans.text: What's over here...? Wait a minute!

units.rawText: What other info can the tracker display?
units.displayText: What other info can the tracker display?

spans.text: What other info can the tracker display?

units.rawText: Other info? Pretty much the only thing it can track is Entropic signals. The red dots on the tracker show their rough locations.
units.displayText: Other info? Pretty much the only thing it can track is Entropic signals. The red dots on the tracker show their rough locations.

spans.text: Other info? Pretty much the only thing it can track is Entropic signals. The red dots on the tracker show their rough locations.

units.rawText: Can you glean anything other than how strong and how close the signals are?
units.displayText: Can you glean anything other than how strong and how close the signals are?

spans.text: Can you glean anything other than how strong and how close the signals are?

units.rawText: I told you, it only displays...
units.displayText: I told you, it only displays...

spans.text: I told you, it only displays...

units.rawText: Wait a minute!
units.displayText: Wait a minute!

spans.text: Wait a minute!

units.rawText: Over here... The signal density in this region is distinctly lower than in other areas!
units.displayText: Over here... The signal density in this region is distinctly lower than in other areas!

spans.text: Over here... The signal density in this region is distinctly lower than in other areas!

units.rawText: Maybe there's something here that she's wary or afraid of!
units.displayText: Maybe there's something here that she's wary or afraid of!

spans.text: Maybe there's something here that she's wary or afraid of!

units.rawText: That's right. Whatever their reason, the Entropics are trying to avoid this place.
units.displayText: That's right. Whatever their reason, the Entropics are trying to avoid this place.

spans.text: That's right. Whatever their reason, the Entropics are trying to avoid this place.

units.rawText: This is our only clue. Let's go!
units.displayText: This is our only clue. Let's go!

spans.text: This is our only clue. Let's go!

units.rawText: Soon, we come to a halt once again.
units.displayText: Soon, we come to a halt once again.

spans.text: Soon, we come to a halt once again.

units.rawText: There is no other path. A flat wall of rock tells us that we have arrived at a dead end.
units.displayText: There is no other path. A flat wall of rock tells us that we have arrived at a dead end.

spans.text: There is no other path. A flat wall of rock tells us that we have arrived at a dead end.

units.rawText: This is it... but it's a dead end.
units.displayText: This is it... but it's a dead end.

spans.text: This is it... but it's a dead end.

units.rawText: Could they have been misdirecting us?
units.displayText: Could they have been misdirecting us?

spans.text: Could they have been misdirecting us?

units.rawText: I don't think so. Her camouflage succeeded, so there'd be no further need to misdirect us.
units.displayText: I don't think so. Her camouflage succeeded, so there'd be no further need to misdirect us.

spans.text: I don't think so. Her camouflage succeeded, so there'd be no further need to misdirect us.
Check the tracker again.

options.rawText: Have Antonina scan the rock wall.
options.displayText: Have Antonina scan the rock wall.

spans.text: Have Antonina scan the rock wall.

units.rawText: Before I can say anything, Antonina is already in action. She opens her terminal and double-checks.
units.displayText: Before I can say anything, Antonina is already in action. She opens her terminal and double-checks.

spans.text: Before I can say anything, Antonina is already in action. She opens her terminal and double-checks.

units.rawText: This IS the place, but why...
units.displayText: This IS the place, but why...

spans.text: This IS the place, but why...

units.rawText: Dammit...!
units.displayText: Dammit...!

spans.text: Dammit...!

units.rawText: Antonina, try scanning the wall.
units.displayText: Antonina, try scanning the wall.

spans.text: Antonina, try scanning the wall.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Initiating analysis mode.
units.displayText: Initiating analysis mode.

spans.text: Initiating analysis mode.

units.rawText: A green scanning beam sweeps over the rock wall in response to Antonina's command.
units.displayText: A green scanning beam sweeps over the rock wall in response to Antonina's command.

spans.text: A green scanning beam sweeps over the rock wall in response to Antonina's command.

units.rawText: One sweep follows another, and the grid-patterned scanlines form a perfect rectangle in the rock wall—
units.displayText: One sweep follows another, and the grid-patterned scanlines form a perfect rectangle in the rock wall—

spans.text: One sweep follows another, and the grid-patterned scanlines form a perfect rectangle in the rock wall—

units.rawText: A perfect rectangle?
units.displayText: A perfect rectangle?

spans.text: A perfect rectangle?

units.rawText: Hang on, Antonina. Don't you think the scanlines are TOO regular?
units.displayText: Hang on, Antonina. Don't you think the scanlines are TOO regular?

spans.text: Hang on, Antonina. Don't you think the scanlines are TOO regular?

units.rawText: So what if they're regular... Wait, do you mean...
units.displayText: So what if they're regular... Wait, do you mean...

spans.text: So what if they're regular... Wait, do you mean...

units.rawText: Antonina realizes what I'm hinting at and gathers her operands to attack the wall.
units.displayText: Antonina realizes what I'm hinting at and gathers her operands to attack the wall.

spans.text: Antonina realizes what I'm hinting at and gathers her operands to attack the wall.

units.rawText: The struck portion of the rock wall glows faintly.
units.displayText: The struck portion of the rock wall glows faintly.

spans.text: The struck portion of the rock wall glows faintly.

units.rawText: The attack then immediately bounces back at where we are, only we were already expecting it and evaded it.
units.displayText: The attack then immediately bounces back at where we are, only we were already expecting it and evaded it.

spans.text: The attack then immediately bounces back at where we are, only we were already expecting it and evaded it.

units.rawText: This isn't an ordinary rock wall; it's a barrier just like the bedrock on the sea floor! There ought to be a path behind it!
units.displayText: This isn't an ordinary rock wall; it's a barrier just like the bedrock on the sea floor! There ought to be a path behind it!

spans.text: This isn't an ordinary rock wall; it's a barrier just like the bedrock on the sea floor! There ought to be a path behind it!

units.rawText: The barrier can block off signals and automatically counterattack. That explains the localized signal disruption... Whoever designed this place is pretty smart.
units.displayText: The barrier can block off signals and automatically counterattack. That explains the localized signal disruption... Whoever designed this place is pretty smart.

spans.text: The barrier can block off signals and automatically counterattack. That explains the localized signal disruption... Whoever designed this place is pretty smart.

units.rawText: Professor... <size=24>You did great.</size>
units.displayText: Professor... You did great.

spans.text: Professor...
You did great.

units.rawText: Mhm.
units.displayText: Mhm.

spans.text: Mhm.
Pretend not to hear.
Proudly accept the compliment.
Remain silent.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: I know you heard me!
units.displayText: I know you heard me!

spans.text: I know you heard me!

units.rawText: Thank you, feel free to keep the praise coming.
units.displayText: Thank you, feel free to keep the praise coming.

spans.text: Thank you, feel free to keep the praise coming.

units.rawText: Tsk.
units.displayText: Tsk.

spans.text: Tsk.

units.rawText: I regret saying that! I take it back!
units.displayText: I regret saying that! I take it back!

spans.text: I regret saying that! I take it back!

units.rawText: She stalks past me and heads straight for the rock wall.
units.displayText: She stalks past me and heads straight for the rock wall.

spans.text: She stalks past me and heads straight for the rock wall.

units.rawText: Ahem, so can you open it?
units.displayText: Ahem, so can you open it?

spans.text: Ahem, so can you open it?

units.rawText: The barrier here is much thinner than the ocean floor. This shouldn't take long. Give me 10 seconds...
units.displayText: The barrier here is much thinner than the ocean floor. This shouldn't take long. Give me 10 seconds...

spans.text: The barrier here is much thinner than the ocean floor. This shouldn't take long. Give me 10 seconds...

units.rawText: Eight seconds later, a ding comes from Antonina's terminal. The rock wall slowly vanishes and blue light spills out from inside.
units.displayText: Eight seconds later, a ding comes from Antonina's terminal. The rock wall slowly vanishes and blue light spills out from inside.

spans.text: Eight seconds later, a ding comes from Antonina's terminal. The rock wall slowly vanishes and blue light spills out from inside.

units.rawText: An azure-colored room appears before us.
units.displayText: An azure-colored room appears before us.

spans.text: An azure-colored room appears before us.

units.rawText: Once we know it's safe, Antonina and I exchange looks before heading in together.
units.displayText: Once we know it's safe, Antonina and I exchange looks before heading in together.

spans.text: Once we know it's safe, Antonina and I exchange looks before heading in together.

units.rawText: This place looks like it's been robbed.
units.displayText: This place looks like it's been robbed.

spans.text: This place looks like it's been robbed.

units.rawText: The Entropic reactions here are very weak and the room's layout is simple and clear. There's nowhere for them to hide.
units.displayText: The Entropic reactions here are very weak and the room's layout is simple and clear. There's nowhere for them to hide.

spans.text: The Entropic reactions here are very weak and the room's layout is simple and clear. There's nowhere for them to hide.

units.rawText: This place... It obviously wasn't built by the High-Order Entropic.
units.displayText: This place... It obviously wasn't built by the High-Order Entropic.

spans.text: This place... It obviously wasn't built by the High-Order Entropic.

units.rawText: Well, the builder—whoever they are—didn't want this room to be found.
units.displayText: Well, the builder—whoever they are—didn't want this room to be found.

spans.text: Well, the builder—whoever they are—didn't want this room to be found.

units.rawText: In any case... Let's investigate this place.
units.displayText: In any case... Let's investigate this place.

spans.text: In any case... Let's investigate this place.
Check the sofa.
Check the table.
Check the computer screen.

units.rawText: The sofa is drenched in liquid Entropy and leaking operands. There are several marker pens lying behind a cushion, half-melted in a puddle of liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: The sofa is drenched in liquid Entropy and leaking operands. There are several marker pens lying behind a cushion, half-melted in a puddle of liquid Entropy.

spans.text: The sofa is drenched in liquid Entropy and leaking operands. There are several marker pens lying behind a cushion, half-melted in a puddle of liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: A purple flower blooms lightly on the back of the sofa.
units.displayText: A purple flower blooms lightly on the back of the sofa.

spans.text: A purple flower blooms lightly on the back of the sofa.

units.rawText: Is this ornamental plant... an Entropic lifeform?
units.displayText: Is this ornamental plant... an Entropic lifeform?

spans.text: Is this ornamental plant... an Entropic lifeform?

units.rawText: It doesn't look like the Entropics we've seen before.
units.displayText: It doesn't look like the Entropics we've seen before.

spans.text: It doesn't look like the Entropics we've seen before.

units.rawText: All the ones we've come across looked like animals. I didn't think there were plant-like Entropics too.
units.displayText: All the ones we've come across looked like animals. I didn't think there were plant-like Entropics too.

spans.text: All the ones we've come across looked like animals. I didn't think there were plant-like Entropics too.

units.rawText: The back of the sofa is structured like a barrier similar to the bedrock. Its degradation was limited to a very small area.
units.displayText: The back of the sofa is structured like a barrier similar to the bedrock. Its degradation was limited to a very small area.

spans.text: The back of the sofa is structured like a barrier similar to the bedrock. Its degradation was limited to a very small area.

units.rawText: ...As I thought, the barrier was used to contain the Entropics.
units.displayText: ...As I thought, the barrier was used to contain the Entropics.

spans.text: ...As I thought, the barrier was used to contain the Entropics.

units.rawText: There's an empty drink can on the table. The can is labeled with a soft drink brand from reality.
units.displayText: There's an empty drink can on the table. The can is labeled with a soft drink brand from reality.

spans.text: There's an empty drink can on the table. The can is labeled with a soft drink brand from reality.

units.rawText: Antonina picks up the terminal on the table.
units.displayText: Antonina picks up the terminal on the table.

spans.text: Antonina picks up the terminal on the table.

units.rawText: It's locked. I need a key to open it.
units.displayText: It's locked. I need a key to open it.

spans.text: It's locked. I need a key to open it.

units.rawText: Can't you just brute-force it?
units.displayText: Can't you just brute-force it?

spans.text: Can't you just brute-force it?

units.rawText: I could, but data that's been encrypted and stored like this are almost always top secret. Carelessly hacking the device might damage the data inside it.
units.displayText: I could, but data that's been encrypted and stored like this are almost always top secret. Carelessly hacking the device might damage the data inside it.

spans.text: I could, but data that's been encrypted and stored like this are almost always top secret. Carelessly hacking the device might damage the data inside it.

units.rawText: If we can't find it in this room, we might have to consider taking it apart.
units.displayText: If we can't find it in this room, we might have to consider taking it apart.

spans.text: If we can't find it in this room, we might have to consider taking it apart.

units.rawText: The computer screen displays the scene under the sea.
units.displayText: The computer screen displays the scene under the sea.

spans.text: The computer screen displays the scene under the sea.

units.rawText: The tsunami seems to have receded and the bottom of the sea is serene once again. Sunlight pours down, creating ripples of light on the sandy ocean floor.
units.displayText: The tsunami seems to have receded and the bottom of the sea is serene once again. Sunlight pours down, creating ripples of light on the sandy ocean floor.

spans.text: The tsunami seems to have receded and the bottom of the sea is serene once again. Sunlight pours down, creating ripples of light on the sandy ocean floor.

units.rawText: ...Why are there no lifeforms in this ocean?
units.displayText: ...Why are there no lifeforms in this ocean?

spans.text: ...Why are there no lifeforms in this ocean?

units.rawText: Even a fish tank would have some ornamental fish in it, right?
units.displayText: Even a fish tank would have some ornamental fish in it, right?

spans.text: Even a fish tank would have some ornamental fish in it, right?

units.rawText: Perhaps there used to be Entropics swimming around in there before.
units.displayText: Perhaps there used to be Entropics swimming around in there before.

spans.text: Perhaps there used to be Entropics swimming around in there before.

units.rawText: Then it would be a sea of death. Who would be so demented as to make something like that?
units.displayText: Then it would be a sea of death. Who would be so demented as to make something like that?

spans.text: Then it would be a sea of death. Who would be so demented as to make something like that?

units.rawText: Antonina picks up the remote control on one side as she quips.
units.displayText: Antonina picks up the remote control on one side as she quips.

spans.text: Antonina picks up the remote control on one side as she quips.

units.rawText: Let's change the channel... We're currently on channel 1, and the next display is... Channel 3.
units.displayText: Let's change the channel... We're currently on channel 1, and the next display is... Channel 3.

spans.text: Let's change the channel... We're currently on channel 1, and the next display is... Channel 3.

units.rawText: She presses a button and the small monitor below lights up, displaying a dimly-lit place.
units.displayText: She presses a button and the small monitor below lights up, displaying a dimly-lit place.

spans.text: She presses a button and the small monitor below lights up, displaying a dimly-lit place.

units.rawText: ...Is this... where we found the first Entropic hive?
units.displayText: ...Is this... where we found the first Entropic hive?

spans.text: ...Is this... where we found the first Entropic hive?

units.rawText: She switches channels twice more and the screen flashes, displaying similar yet subtly different scenes.
units.displayText: She switches channels twice more and the screen flashes, displaying similar yet subtly different scenes.

spans.text: She switches channels twice more and the screen flashes, displaying similar yet subtly different scenes.

units.rawText: We just explored these places. I can tell from here.
units.displayText: We just explored these places. I can tell from here.

spans.text: We just explored these places. I can tell from here.

units.rawText: So this... is a surveillance room...
units.displayText: So this... is a surveillance room...

spans.text: So this... is a surveillance room...

units.rawText: Every single move the Entropics made underground was under observation.
units.displayText: Every single move the Entropics made underground was under observation.

spans.text: Every single move the Entropics made underground was under observation.

units.rawText: So that's why that High-Order Entropic couldn't come near this place.
units.displayText: So that's why that High-Order Entropic couldn't come near this place.

spans.text: So that's why that High-Order Entropic couldn't come near this place.

units.rawText: We still don't know enough. Let's look elsewhere.
units.displayText: We still don't know enough. Let's look elsewhere.

spans.text: We still don't know enough. Let's look elsewhere.
Check the wall.
Check the noticeboard.
Check the bookshelf.

units.rawText: The wall is relatively clean, but there are quite a few long, narrow marks on it, as well as some crudely-scrawled graffiti.
units.displayText: The wall is relatively clean, but there are quite a few long, narrow marks on it, as well as some crudely-scrawled graffiti.

spans.text: The wall is relatively clean, but there are quite a few long, narrow marks on it, as well as some crudely-scrawled graffiti.

units.rawText: Judging by the frenzied handwriting, the agent who left it was in a very unstable state of mind.
units.displayText: Judging by the frenzied handwriting, the agent who left it was in a very unstable state of mind.

spans.text: Judging by the frenzied handwriting, the agent who left it was in a very unstable state of mind.

units.rawText: These long marks are scratch marks. Like this...
units.displayText: These long marks are scratch marks. Like this...

spans.text: These long marks are scratch marks. Like this...

units.rawText: She scratches the wall, producing an ear-piercing noise as her fingernails scrape across the surface.
units.displayText: She scratches the wall, producing an ear-piercing noise as her fingernails scrape across the surface.

spans.text: She scratches the wall, producing an ear-piercing noise as her fingernails scrape across the surface.

units.rawText: But it must have taken a very strong agent to make marks like these.
units.displayText: But it must have taken a very strong agent to make marks like these.

spans.text: But it must have taken a very strong agent to make marks like these.

units.rawText: After all, the operand density of a process is usually far lower than that of a structure.
units.displayText: After all, the operand density of a process is usually far lower than that of a structure.

spans.text: After all, the operand density of a process is usually far lower than that of a structure.

units.rawText: Several slips of paper are pinned to the notice board. Some of them have been scratched to pieces by something, while others are largely intact.
units.displayText: Several slips of paper are pinned to the notice board. Some of them have been scratched to pieces by something, while others are largely intact.

spans.text: Several slips of paper are pinned to the notice board. Some of them have been scratched to pieces by something, while others are largely intact.

units.rawText: Antonina approaches and reads each of them.
units.displayText: Antonina approaches and reads each of them.

spans.text: Antonina approaches and reads each of them.

units.rawText: "Report ID 11: Alpha is estimated to awaken 15 days after the barrier reconstruction. Today's aim: Observe Alpha's evolution status."
units.displayText: "Report ID 11: Alpha is estimated to awaken 15 days after the barrier reconstruction. Today's aim: Observe Alpha's evolution status."

spans.text: "Report ID 11: Alpha is estimated to awaken 15 days after the barrier reconstruction. Today's aim: Observe Alpha's evolution status."

units.rawText: "Report ID 55: Alpha's intelligence has awakened."
units.displayText: "Report ID 55: Alpha's intelligence has awakened."

spans.text: "Report ID 55: Alpha's intelligence has awakened."

units.rawText: <color=orange>"Alpha"?</color>
units.displayText: "Alpha"?

spans.text: "Alpha"?

units.rawText: That might very well be her.
units.displayText: That might very well be her.

spans.text: That might very well be her.

units.rawText: All these paper slips have dates on them. The latest one was from two years ago.
units.displayText: All these paper slips have dates on them. The latest one was from two years ago.

spans.text: All these paper slips have dates on them. The latest one was from two years ago.

units.rawText: "Report ID 161: Alpha has begun to express desires and has repeatedly sent certain messages. Upon decryption, they read "Demiurge".
units.displayText: "Report ID 161: Alpha has begun to express desires and has repeatedly sent certain messages. Upon decryption, they read "Demiurge".

spans.text: "Report ID 161: Alpha has begun to express desires and has repeatedly sent certain messages. Upon decryption, they read "Demiurge".

units.rawText: "Report ID 231: Contact with Alpha has been stopped per directives"... Part of this slip was torn off and I can't see the rest.
units.displayText: "Report ID 231: Contact with Alpha has been stopped per directives"... Part of this slip was torn off and I can't see the rest.

spans.text: "Report ID 231: Contact with Alpha has been stopped per directives"... Part of this slip was torn off and I can't see the rest.

units.rawText: "Report ID 1150: Orders rewritten, restarting experiment."
units.displayText: "Report ID 1150: Orders rewritten, restarting experiment."

spans.text: "Report ID 1150: Orders rewritten, restarting experiment."

units.rawText: So the Entropics here were reared after all.
units.displayText: So the Entropics here were reared after all.

spans.text: So the Entropics here were reared after all.

units.rawText: Probably. I'm guessing Alpha was the High-Order Entropic we encountered. She was their research subject.
units.displayText: Probably. I'm guessing Alpha was the High-Order Entropic we encountered. She was their research subject.

spans.text: Probably. I'm guessing Alpha was the High-Order Entropic we encountered. She was their research subject.

units.rawText: I suppose we can call her that. But the rest of the messages are pretty much unreadable.
units.displayText: I suppose we can call her that. But the rest of the messages are pretty much unreadable.

spans.text: I suppose we can call her that. But the rest of the messages are pretty much unreadable.

units.rawText: Antonina hands me the remaining slips of paper so that I can see for myself.
units.displayText: Antonina hands me the remaining slips of paper so that I can see for myself.

spans.text: Antonina hands me the remaining slips of paper so that I can see for myself.

units.rawText: The papers are covered in blocks of color that are hard to make out. Only parts of the text make sense to me.
units.displayText: The papers are covered in blocks of color that are hard to make out. Only parts of the text make sense to me.

spans.text: The papers are covered in blocks of color that are hard to make out. Only parts of the text make sense to me.

units.displayText: Look out!

units.displayText: The avatar of darkness stretches herself and gives voice to an earth-shaking cry of joy.

55.name: Observation Logs on Demiurge
55.description:
Logs found in a mysterious underground room in the Copley Sector contain information concerning Demiurge, a High-order Entropic.
 The following are excerpts from the logs:

 "It has been 643 days since the former PIC gave the termination command. I have received an order from Magrasea to restart the experiment tomorrow."

 "...Report ID1286: Expanding on the foundation of the previous experiment, I attempted to carve the target's torso into 24 parts and observed its regeneration rate. The target struggled for 19 hours until it fully recovered. No discernible change observed in the target's regeneration rate. Verification of certain hypotheses can be left till the next experiment."
 "Experimentation has come to a standstill. I requested data of the former PIC from the current PIC, but have received no reply thus far."

 "...Report ID1305: The number of disposable embedded Sector Agents has increased to five, all were consumed by the target. No discernible signs of rejection after 15 hours of observation. Following established procedures, I will attempt to carve up the target..."
 "The number of Sector Agents has decreased slightly, which is having certain effects on the ecosystem research function in the Copley Sector. The current PIC has expressed no objections. Contact with humans is impossible at the moment, so I will prioritize the current PIC's input. On a different note, I have detected slight fluctuations in my own neural cloud, the cause is to be determined..."

 "...Report ID1413: Attempted to embed Sanctifiers and Sector Agents following preset ratio no. 19. All were consumed by the target, which has yet to show any signs of proliferation. Following established procedures, I will attempt to carve up the target..."
 "The experiment ended in yet another failure. My neural cloud also seems to have undergone certain changes due to a prolonged period of self-determination. However, the clearer my thoughts become, the harder it is to reconcile myself with the necessary research procedures..."
 "These days, I can almost feel my neural cloud slowing down whenever I am face-to-face with Demiurge. According to Report ID1241, Entropy should have no direct effect on me. Perhaps my neural cloud has been damaged during the current PIC's takeover. I will verify with the PIC when the opportunity arises."
 "...Report ID2314: Erroneous computation..."
 "My neural cloud has been deteriorating rapidly all of a sudden. I will prioritize completing my allocated tasks and reduce Operand consumption in other activities. As per the PIC's instructions, I will attempt to deactivate some of my modules..."
 "Basic functional modules will be shut down in approximately 34 hours. Neural record of unknown origin has been discovered."
 "According to current settings, this record will be played just before my neural cloud is purged. This day might come sooner than I thought. Though this record remains completely inaccessible, I can hear a voice inside my head, telling me to preserve it. Perhaps I will wander endlessly inside this cage in the future. I hope intruders that accidentally venture into the Copley Sector will not fall into my trap so easily..."
 "..."
